Preconditions were verified rather than taken from the producer's report: S4's equality claim was re-measured over the 11 vendored modules the package BUILD_MANIFEST declares, not the 9 I first found under data/assets/scripts/silver (that narrower read was corrected before Leg C), giving 11 of 11 byte-equal; silver_build_commit.schwab reads 47c3c75f11; pytest over the silver suite read 597 passed, 11 skipped, 0 failed; and the three ratified edits are present as written, with the NOT_PUBLISHED disposition applied under an `if x not in bronze` guard, which is the CTO half's narrowing that a landed slm file is never suppressed. This project had already settled the same collision for an earlier seat's NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-OG-S1 by continuing the Z-S series, so these rows are Z-S68 and Z-S69 (max in channel was Z-S67, read across all 86 hits rather than off one page).
